corridors.regulationNote: Domestic USD, same country and currency. Bank account only; no crypto route in this corridor.
Cross-border USD to PHP. Bank account, e-wallet and crypto-wallet destinations; simulated rails only.
Cross-border GBP to PHP over tGBP on Solana. Tazapay sandbox pays bank accounts from a GBP balance; other rails simulated.
Cross-border USD to BRL. Bank account and crypto-wallet destinations. Brazil is the baseline Latin American country; Mexico is added after the event.

Bank rails only. Draft cross-border crypto rules of 3 Aug 2026 would stop companies sending or receiving crypto across the border; on 21 Oct 2026 the finance minister said they will be rewritten, with no timeline. Demo policy, not legal advice.
UK GBP to tGBP (Tokenised GBP) on Solana. Crypto-wallet destination only; no fiat payout. Simulated collect and 1:1 conversion; settlement is verified on-chain.
Cross-border GBP to EUR over tGBP on Solana. Tazapay sandbox prices and pays local bank accounts from a GBP balance; sandbox only.
